concurrency: Single-threaded pure compilation; one bounded compile per call over immutable normalized resources; no shared mutable state, no worker, thread, coroutine, timer, or background work. Compiler-emitted structures are fresh and owned by the caller; the volatile run envelope is the only per-call value and never enters the plan body.
inputs: immutable normalized resources and their canonical content
purpose: Record the exact declared input provenance (normalized source hashes plus an input semantic digest) in the resolved plan so a downstream consumer can verify plan, Profile and API versions and normalized source hashes without reparsing YAML, keeping schema, resource, Profile and artifact versions independent.
state: Stateless digest computation over immutable normalized content plus the volatile byte-digest envelope.

static_checks.expected: literal inspection shows RESOURCE_DOMAIN_SEPARATOR, INPUT_DOMAIN_SEPARATOR and include_source_map=False
static_checks.rule: resource and input digests use the frozen domain separators and canonical_json without source maps
static_checks.tool: repository static inspection (python ast parse, jsonschema meta-schema validation, additive diff scope check)
